displayName: Trade flow — gold in vs gold out per hour
description: STAGE 1 SEED. Measures gold-in / gold-out per hour across playstyle and hours-played. Expected bands: balanced → net positive ~50g/hour; craft-heavy → net positive ~100g/hour; enchanting-focused → net near zero (buying reagents offsets selling). Currently descriptive only — the playbook runner infrastructure supports kind=combat and kind=crafting; an economy evaluator is stage-2 work. This file documents expected bands so that evaluator can be written against them.
